Name: Collection Progress Helper
Author: VISION21A
Description:
Description / 描述

Collection Progress Helper is a lightweight Stardew Valley UI mod for the Collections menu. It reveals missing collection entries as their actual item icons and adds clearer progress/source hints to tooltips.

收藏进度助手是一个面向星露谷收藏界面的轻量 UI 模组。它会把收藏页中未完成条目的问号显示为对应物品图标，并在悬停提示中加入更清晰的完成状态与来源提示。

Installation / 安装

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download and unzip this mod.
3. Put the CollectionRevealPlus folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

1. 安装 SMAPI。
2. 下载并解压本模组。
3. 将 CollectionRevealPlus 文件夹放入 Stardew Valley/Mods。
4. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。

Main Features / 主要功能

- Reveals missing collection icons instead of showing only question marks.
- Adds progress status to tooltips, such as not shipped, not caught, not donated, recipe not learned, or not cooked yet.
- Adds Chinese source hints for crops, forage, shops, fish locations/seasons/weather/time, cooking recipes, minerals, artifacts, secret notes, and letters.
- Keeps cooked recipes visually normal and marks recipes you have not learned yet with a border.
- Filters untranslated/internal mod IDs so they do not appear directly in tooltips.
- UI-only: does not edit saves, change item acquisition, or alter gameplay balance.

- 显示未完成收藏条目的真实图标，不再只显示问号。
- 在提示框中显示完成状态，例如未出货、未钓到、未捐献、未学会配方、尚未烹饪等。
- 为作物、采集物、商店、鱼类地点/季节/天气/时间、菜谱、矿物、古物、秘密纸条和信件添加中文来源提示。
- 烹饪页保持原版视觉风格，并用边框标记尚未学会配方的料理。
- 过滤未翻译或内部英文 ID，避免它们直接显示在提示框中。
- 仅修改 UI 显示：不修改存档，不改变物品获取方式，不影响游戏平衡。

Requirements / 前置需求

- SMAPI
- Stardew Valley 1.6+

Compatibility / 兼容性

This mod should work with most content mods. For modded items, it uses the game data available at runtime. If a mod does not provide localized fields, this mod will use safe Chinese fallback text instead of showing raw internal IDs.

本模组应兼容大多数内容扩展模组。对于模组新增物品，它会读取游戏运行时的数据。如果某个模组没有提供本地化字段，本模组会使用中文兜底文本，而不是直接显示内部英文 ID。

Notes / 说明

The source hints are meant as quick in-game guidance, not a full wiki replacement. Some rare or heavily modded items may show generalized source text.
来源提示主要用于游戏内快速参考，并不完全替代百科。部分稀有物品或深度模组物品可能会显示较概括的来源。
